titles.title: Spirit Of God (I Can Almost See)

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I can almost see Your holiness
As I look around this place

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
With my hands stretched out
To receive Your love

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: I can see You on each face

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Spirit of God, lift me up
Spirit of God, lift me up

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Fill me again with Your love
Sweet Spirit of God
